subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in LINE same-sender media batching, design a shared media-batching contract first, or keep heuristic batching unsupported for channels without native grouping metadata?
rationale: LINE has no reliable album id, and automation should not choose the public config key, default latency, grouping key, flush-on-text behavior, or plugin-versus-core ownership for delayed webhook semantics.

options.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin setting that batches only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

options.title: Defer as product choice
options.body: Keep the issue open but require live LINE evidence and maintainer design approval before adding a config surface.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Document that users should rely on existing queue/collect behavior or resend media together, accepting that LINE rapid media remains unbatched.

recommendation.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin setting that batches only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent LINE plugin history and the current handler/config ownership signal make this the best available routing candidate for choosing the LINE product boundary.
